page.notes: The left page is only a sliver at the scan edge; its lines are cut off and are given as one fragment. Show-through: faint mirrored text across the upper part of the right page (under the title area and the top margin) is not printed on this page and is left out; no running head is legible as printed text. The "J" in "Jecuritatem" is printed as a long s and is transcribed as securitatem. The Greek word ἀφόβως and the "m" in "instituera m." are as far as I can read them; the line in the upper part of the text is clear but the Greek accents may be imperfect. The left-margin "Æ." sits at the cut edge and is not included.
